name: S33 risk-scaled Nasdaq growth
objective: Higher after-cost CAGR, accepting substantial drawdowns; not a promise of alpha
decision: Weekly risk rebalancing plus daily risk-off exits; previous completed close signals fill at next close
allocation: Use QQQ up to 1x exposure; above 1x mix fully funded QQQ and TQQQ. No margin, shorting, synthetic pre-inception ETF or broker runner
benchmarks: S12-style original targets with common funded next-close execution
S12-style scaled to the challenger risk budget with common execution
screen: Primary evaluation CAGR exceeds both QQQ and original-risk S12-style; primary maximum drawdown better than -60%; same comparisons hold with doubled costs and two-session fills; primary recent total return positive
selection: One primary hypothesis. Publish every neighbor and sensitivity; do not pick the winner or retune after results
limitations: All windows are retrospective; repository history and market outcomes have already been seen
2008 is absent because actual TQQQ did not exist
35% realized QQQ volatility sizing does not guarantee portfolio volatility, drawdown or exposure limits between trades
Nasdaq concentration and leveraged ETF daily reset/path dependence remain
Zero MXN cash primary; fixed cash yield is a sensitivity, never historical Bondia
No claim to beat all repository strategies, including S14 without canonical comparable histories
S32 rejection and all existing safety/graduation blocks remain unchanged
source_caveat: These papers motivate testable trend/volatility hypotheses, not this parameterization, ETF implementation or expected future profitability
